edits.old: Figure 2 · The Experience Loop. Consequence updates Canvas state. The changed Painting then participates in the interpretation of the next moment.
edits.new: Figure 2 · The Experience Loop. Follow the arrows from a situated moment through interpretation, choice, action, and consequence. The return changes Canvas state; the next moment is interpreted through that changed Painting.
edits.reason: Explain how to read the new loop diagram and distinguish retained change from production of the external event.

edits.old: This loop is the most accessible bridge in DOT because the reader can observe its parts before accepting the full derivation. Within the framework, Little c precedes the biological interface and Rendering Latency names the proposed handoff. What remains hypothetical relative to public evidence is how that placement can be operationally distinguished and measured.
edits.new: The loop can be examined without accepting DOT’s ontology. DOT places Little c prior to the biological interface and calls the proposed handoff Rendering Latency. Distinguishing and measuring that handoff remains an empirical task.
